title: Panda
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with all 18 original Korean pages

pages.text: Rustle, rustle! A sound comes from the misty bamboo forest far away. Who could it be?
Hello! A round, black-and-white friend appears between the bamboo stalks. It's a panda!
A panda has both white fur and black fur. Its body is white, and its arms and legs are black.
Its round ears are jet black! It holds them up to listen carefully.
Black circles surround its eyes. These markings make its expressions easy to see.
Look at its front paws! Beside its fingers is a special bone it uses like a thumb. That helps it grip bamboo.
Crunch, munch! A panda eats bamboo all day. It can spend more than twelve hours a day eating!
Pandas are good climbers, too! They climb trees with their round bodies and rest comfortably up high.
Roll, roll! A panda sometimes rolls down a hill. It has lots of fun playing on its own.
Pandas like living alone. They rub against trees to leave their scent and tell other pandas, This is my territory!
Oh! What's that sound? When a panda hears something unfamiliar, it quickly climbs a tree to hide.
What does a baby panda look like when it is born? Let's take a little peek together!
Wow! A newborn panda is tiny, with pink skin and just a little white fur. It is much, much smaller than its mother!
As time passes, the baby grows black-and-white fur. Beside its mother, it learns to walk with wobbly little steps.
As pandas eat bamboo and move through the forest, they help spread seeds from place to place. What wonderful friends they are to the forest!
A panda strolls slowly through the misty bamboo forest. What a calm and wonderful friend!
Can you find the panda's black eye markings and its special front paws for holding bamboo?
I'm the easygoing panda, a favorite friend in the bamboo forest! Now, who shall we meet next?
